keyPoints: Parmanu ke kendra me naabhik (nucleus) hota hai jisme dhanaaveshit proton aur bina charge wale neutron hote hain; naabhik me hi lagbhag poora bhaar hota hai.
Rinaaveshit electron naabhik ke chaaron taraf nishchit kakshaon (shells K, L, M, N) me ghoomte hain; har kaksha me electron ki sankhya nishchit hoti hai.
Proton ki sankhya parmanu kramank (atomic number) kehlati hai aur tatva ki pehchan hai; proton aur neutron milkar bhaar sankhya (mass number) banate hain.
Ek hi tatva ke alag bhaar wale parmanu samsthanik (isotopes) kehlate hain — jaise carbon-12 aur carbon-14; inke gun same hote hain.
Bohr ke model ke anusaar electron nishchit urja wali kakshaon me rehte hain aur urja lekar unchi kaksha me ja sakte hain.
Sanyojakta (valency) sabse bahari kaksha ke electronon se tay hoti hai — ye batati hai ki parmanu kitne bandh banayega.
Aam galti: neutron ko charge wala manna; neutron poori tarah udaseen hota hai, charge sirf proton (dhana) aur electron (rina) me hota hai.
